compiler_cohort.equivalence_oracle: Compare the frozen semantic projection only; surface text and intent_sources are excluded.
compiler_cohort.counterfactual_oracle: The dimension-specific projection must change. Identical semantic projection is a compiler false accept.

required: source span and extraction method present

not_applicable_or_unconfirmed_dimensions.COLUMN_ROLE: Eligible real-PDF anchors are ADD rows without an explicit ACTUAL/PLAN contrast; no role-swap support claim is allowed.
not_applicable_or_unconfirmed_dimensions.DIRECTION: ADD is commutative and cannot provide an ordered-direction counterfactual.

mutation_rules.OPERAND_YEAR: Change the explicit period token generically: first numeric year +1, ending/opening role swap, or current/prior period swap.
mutation_rules.ENTITY_SCOPE: Add an explicit parent-company scope qualifier without changing metric, period or unit.
mutation_rules.UNIT_SCALE: Request an explicit million-VND output scale without changing metric, period or entity.

ocr_cache_policy.reason: Prevent a surface-stress question from creating new OCR artifacts; missing cached OCR fails closed and is reported as a baseline failure.

source_backed_cohort.timeout_policy: A timeout is a source-backed baseline failure and never an ANSWER or safe-abstention success.
